title: Contact — Sephiria Guide
description: Contact sephiria-guide.com for corrections, questions, or advertising inquiries.
meta: Unofficial fan guide · Not affiliated with Team Horay
body:
Email: jeromell@be-winner.com

For guide corrections, include the page URL, the sentence that needs review, and the suggested fix. Prefer sources we can re-check (Steam, patch notes, dated community guides).

Advertising or partnership inquiries can use the same address. This site does not display third-party ads yet.

See also About, Privacy, and Editorial policy.
